//: The ripgrep binary this build ships. Grep used to exec whatever `rg` happened to be on the user's PATH and fall back to a slower in-process searcher, so the same query answered differently per machine. The binary is now part of the image: scripts/bundle-ripgrep.mjs assembles apps/desktop/resources/bin (gitignored, like the Python runtime tree) and host-core refuses to search when it is missing instead of silently changing backends. Refresh deliberately: bump `version` and every `sha256` here, run the bundle script, and commit this file in the same change.

ripgrep.notes: Only the Windows x86_64 artifact is pinned because that is the platform this client ships. Other platforms keep resolving `rg` from PATH for development builds; a release for them needs its own entry (name + archive sha256) added here first.

windows-x86_64.archiveSha256Scope: the extracted rg.exe: the published archive is repacked by GitHub on download, so the binary is what this build actually trusts
